adjudication.rationale: Looking at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts lines 6-14, the code performs a fetch to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT without any timeout/abort controller. If the sync service is unavailable or slow, this fetch will hang indefinitely, blocking the token refresh operation and consequently any booking requests that require refreshed tokens. This is a real defect - network calls to external services should have timeouts to prevent indefinite blocking.
